## ORDER:

श्रीकृष्ण

In the reference 8th read above, Government have issued orders for sanction of
DA @ 3.64%, due from 01.01.2024 to the employees of State Government and also
ordered to pay the arrears from 01.01.2024 to 30.09.2025 at the time of their exit from
Government Service.

2. Government after careful consideration of the entire matter and keeping in view
of the welfare of the employees, have decided to pay the arrears for the employees as
detailed below:

A. 10% of the arrears to be paid in April 2026.

i. For the OPS employees, arrears will be credited to General Provident Fund
(GPF) account.

ii. For the CPS employees, including PTD employees who have opted CPS and
governed by the CPS, the arrears will be paid duly crediting the 10% of the arrear
amount to the PRAN accounts of the individuals along with the Government
share as per G.O.Ms.No.250, Finance (Pen. I) Department, dated 06-09-2012.

iii. For EPS-95 employees, the arrears of DA shall be calculated as per the rules
governed by the EPS-95 and paid accordingly.

B. The remaining 90% to be paid in three equal installments in the months of August 2026, November 2026 and February 2027, as detailed below:

i. For the OPS employees, amount will be credited to General Provident Fund
(GPF) account.
